label: Web Search
description: Search the web (semantic + keyword, auto-picked per query) and get results with their page text, ready for an LLM step. Powered by Exa.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Exa access (wire an ExaAccess node).

inputs.name: includeDomains
inputs.description: Only results from these domains. Empty = the whole web.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Each result: title, url, publishedDate, text.
